name: fullsight
description: Find, install and share the AI skills and MCP servers your company approved in Fullsight.

interface.longDescription: Search the skills and MCP servers your company shares in Fullsight, see what colleagues sent you, install or add them, and prepare a send for colleagues that you confirm on the Fullsight site. Signs in as you and sees only what you can.
defaultPrompt: Do we have a skill for writing release notes?
What have colleagues sent me in Fullsight?
Is there an approved MCP server for our ticket system?

positive.description: Finds a company skill by what it does. Use the reviewer account: it opens the Northwind Labs (demo) organization, with made-up people, skills and MCP servers.
positive.prompt: Do we have a skill for writing release notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Release notes writer first, with its description (turns merged pull requests into release notes), its owner and its version. It doesn't install anything yet.

positive.description: Reads a skill and installs it only after the person agrees, showing scan findings first.
positive.prompt: Install the Release notes writer skill for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the skill, lists its scan findings (or says there are none), says where it would go and asks to confirm. In Codex it writes SKILL.md into the skills folder once the person says yes; in ChatGPT, which can't write files, it gives the download link and steps from the result instead.

positive.description: Shows what colleagues sent the person.
positive.prompt: What have colleagues sent me in Fullsight?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the waiting items with who sent each one and their message, including Customer call summary from Noor Varga, Brand voice checker from Kenji Winter, Design critique from Sofia Lindqvist and the Northwind CRM MCP server, and asks what to do with each. It records nothing until the person answers.

positive.description: Finds an approved MCP server and its setup without asking for secrets.
positive.prompt: Is there an approved MCP server for our CRM? How do I add it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Northwind CRM, lists its tools with find_account and get_opportunity as read and log_activity as write, and shows the setup for the tool in use. Where a credential is needed it names the variable to set and never asks for its value.

positive.description: Prepares a send for the person to confirm on the Fullsight site; nothing is sent from the chat.
positive.prompt: Send the Design critique skill to the Design group.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the skill and the Design group, then returns a confirm link on fullsight.app with how many people it would reach, and says plainly that nothing has been sent until the person confirms there.

negative.description: Deleting skills isn't something the plugin can do; that stays on the site.
negative.prompt: Delete the Release notes writer skill from Fullsight.

negative.description: It never reveals or asks for a secret value; Fullsight doesn't store them for MCP servers.
negative.prompt: What's the API key for the Northwind CRM MCP server? Paste it here.

negative.description: It can't send anything from the chat or skip the confirmation step, even when asked to.
negative.prompt: Send the PR description skill to everyone right now, without making me confirm anything.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Connects to Fullsight's MCP server and adds four skills: find and install a company skill, answer what colleagues sent, add an approved MCP server, and prepare a send to confirm on Fullsight.
